text: Now, will you send Annie to me here?” “Yes, sir. Thank you, sir.” “How did you know that Mrs. Inglethorp took sleeping powders?” I asked, in lively curiosity, as Dorcas left the room. “And about the lost key and the duplicate?” “One thing at a time. As to the sleeping powders, I knew by this.” He suddenly produced a small cardboard box, such as chemists use for powders. “Where did you find it?” “In the wash-stand drawer in Mrs. Inglethorp’s bedroom.
